entries.description:
原创 直播技术团队 2026-09-11 16:32 浙江 一套借鉴认知科学的本地长期记忆系统

HL-Mem 是一套旨在让 Agent 像人一样具备长期记忆能力的本地化记忆系统，其核心设计理念是将记忆视为受治理的认知系统而非简单的数据存储…
entries.summary: HL-Mem is a local, long-term memory system for AI agents, inspired by cognitive science. It treats memory as a governed cognitive system rather than simple storage. Using a dual-channel architecture, it distinguishes between immutable events and structured, updatable facts. Key features include traceable evidence, temporal reasoning, and controlled forgetting. Designed for local-first deployment, it relies primarily on SQLite, ensuring low complexity and high controllability. HL-Mem enables agents to retain, update, and forget information, supporting sustainable long-term interaction with minimal infrastructure.

entries.description:
原创 直播技术团队 2026-09-09 17:41 浙江 Agent 断点续传全链路实践

本文介绍了针对 Agent 长程任务中断恢复需求的完整实践方案，旨在解决用户主动、工具执行及系统级中断带来的稳定性问题。该方案采用“框架层…
entries.summary: This article details a checkpoint-based solution for resuming interrupted long-running AI agent tasks. By extending the Spring AI Alibaba framework with custom hooks, the system preserves state during collaborative interruptions without modifying core source code. An upper-layer scheduler coordinates cross-process recovery by managing task records and using message queue traffic stripping to prevent data loss during shutdowns. This two-tier architecture ensures stability across human-in-the-loop, multi-agent coordination, and system restart scenarios.

entries.summary: bybt-data-analysis-assistant is a Taobao data analysis agent that automates data retrieval and attribution using natural language. It employs a multi-agent architecture with intent recognition and a ReAct loop to execute complex queries. Key innovations include an NL2MDL2SQL pipeline for accurate, standardized SQL generation, a six-layer knowledge base for semantic consistency, and AST-based lineage parsing. The system supports automated metric decomposition for fluctuation diagnosis, accelerated Hologres querying, and a rigorous evaluation framework to ensure reliable, self-correcting analytical insights for business users.

entries.title: AI 驱动研发体系的实践和思考
entries.description:
原创 营销&交易技术 2026-09-02 16:08 浙江 AI 驱动研发：本地优先与知识飞轮实践

本文总结了团队在 AI 驱动研发体系的实践探索，从 AI 辅助编程发展到完整的 AI 驱动研发体系…
entries.summary: A Taobao team evolved from AI-assisted coding to an AI-driven R&D system. The core insight: business AI's bottleneck is context, not model capability. Their "local-first" approach uses Git-managed folders where agents operate on business knowledge, code, rules, and verification evidence together. Projects need not wait for perfect knowledge bases; iteration itself creates a knowledge flywheel. The system separates human decision-making from agent execution, with structured protocols for each development phase. As general agent capabilities improve, project-specific tooling will shrink, but business knowledge governance and end-to-end delivery responsibility remain essential. Future technical roles will resemble Forward Deployed Engineers, deeply embedded in business context.
